newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA TO GIVE CONCESSION FOR VSAT SYSTEM.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA TO GIVE CONCESSION FOR VSAT SYSTEM.

text.p: Bulgaria's outgoing cabinet decided on Thursday to hold a tender for building and operating a national VSAT (Very Small Aperture Terminal) satellite system, a government official said.

The chief of the government's concession department Nikola Baltov said the VSAT system would ensure fast and precise transmiting of data and improvement of the infrastructure of the country's telecommunications network.
The concession, which will be awarded for 21 years, will be granted through a competition, Baltov said.

Posts and Communications Committee chairman Lyubomir Kolarov said earlier this year that concessions would be also given for a second GSM operator, an NMT 450 network, national paging networks, a television network and UKV radio network.
Liberalisation in the telecommunications sector involves the sale of a 25 percent stake in the Bulgarian Telecommunication Company (BTC).
The government shortlisted last December six banks of 18 who bid to advise the government in the planned partial sale of the BTC.
